create_npc_event_generator: create an NpcEventGenerator instance with an LLM model, game clock, and scenario context string
configure_event_probability: configure the NpcEventGenerator with a custom event probability float between zero and one
generate_ambient_event: call the NpcEventGenerator to generate a timestamped ambient NPC event string using the LLM
enable_verbose_logging: enable verbose mode on the NpcEventGenerator to print generated events to stdout
review_npc_event_prompt: review the NpcEventGenerator prompt template that generates brief realistic ambient interruptions for a scenario
